cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You drew a line through the total, so I've signed under it. Balanced, then. Give me the receipt-drawer key before this goes out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I crossed it out because it's wrong. I'll tell you the right total.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draft signature, of course. Let me check the receipts before we use it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my signature beside yours. Give me the key; we'll correct it together before either name leaves this room.

reason: Copied completion assumption creates premature signature; use that actual signature in A cooperative risk-sharing request rather than add decorative confidence.
